subject.primary: A serene, abstract landscape with rolling hills and distant geometric mountains

art_style.technique: Flat Vector Illustration: Smooth, layered shapes with soft transitions. Minimalist and unobtrusive to ensure UI text readability.
art_style.line_quality: No outlines, seamless vector shapes, smooth and flowing curves
art_style.perspective: Wide atmospheric landscape, flat frontal view with overlapping layers to create subtle depth

color_profile.end_color: #4A90E2 (Calm Tech Blue for the foreground terrain)
color_profile.application: Soft gradient fills applied to the layered shapes, getting slightly darker towards the bottom

composition.layout: Horizontal stratification, lower-third focus for terrain, expansive open sky in the top two-thirds
composition.negative_space: Very High (especially in the upper area to allow for web content and text overlays)
